title: SEP-0023 v1.4.0 invalid vector #8, muxed account (M): Invalid algorithm (low 3 bits of version byte are 7)
why: A published SEP-0023 vector that every decoder must reject (invalid algorithm (low 3 bits of version byte are 7)); a decoder that accepts it stores an address that is not the one the bytes say, or one that cannot exist.

reject.note: Read from the bytes, the checksum was not recomputed after the version byte was changed, so a decoder that verifies the checksum first refuses it as strkey_checksum.
